### Headline summary
- US tech stocks tumbled as investors reassessed heavy AI capital expenditures and fears of a bubble grew. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/tech-stocks-poised-to-drop-after-amazon-adds-to-ai-spending-fear), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/intel-shares-plunge-revenue-drop-warning-ai-led-supply-shortages-2026-10), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/amazon-intel-selloffs-ai-spending-investor-scrutiny-3809202), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/stocks-plunge-investors-question-ai-spending-intel-outlook-3809231))
- Major tech companies have committed over $3 trillion to AI infrastructure, resulting in a 15-year low in cash returned to shareholders. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/big-tech-holds-3-trillion-in-spending-commitments-for-ai-boom), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p20#a261030p20))
- DeepSeek completed a nearly $16 billion funding round involving Chinese state players amid surging black market Nvidia chip prices. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/behind-deepseeks-16-billion-funding-chinese-tech-titans-state-players), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261029/p71#a261029p71))

### Tech stocks fall on AI spending concerns
US tech stocks tumbled, with Amazon and Intel shares plunging after earnings reports highlighted high AI capital expenditures and disappointing outlooks, driving fears of an AI bubble. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/tech-stocks-poised-to-drop-after-amazon-adds-to-ai-spending-fear), [Business Insider](https://www.businessinsider.com/intel-shares-plunge-revenue-drop-warning-ai-led-supply-shortages-2026-10), [International Business Times](https://www.ibtimes.com/amazon-intel-shares-fall-ai-spending-pc-market-3809185), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/future-society/stock-market-bloodbath-ai-bubble-earnings))

### Big Tech commits $3 trillion to AI infrastructure
Major tech companies including Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Meta, and Oracle have committed over $3 trillion to AI spending, resulting in a 15-year low in cash returned to shareholders. ([Bloomberg Technology](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-10-30/big-tech-holds-3-trillion-in-spending-commitments-for-ai-boom), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p20#a261030p20), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p22#a261030p22))

### DeepSeek raises $16B funding round
DeepSeek completed a nearly $16 billion funding round involving Chinese state players, with the round size doubled due to surging black market Nvidia chip prices. ([The Information](https://www.theinformation.com/articles/behind-deepseeks-16-billion-funding-chinese-tech-titans-state-players), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261029/p71#a261029p71))

### Google Suncatcher satellite generates first AI response
Google's Project Suncatcher prototype satellite, equipped with a TPU, went online and generated its first AI response, a haiku, from space. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/10/30/googles-first-data-center-satellite-is-online-and-writing-poetry/), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/project-suncatchers-orbiting-tpu-delivers-its-first-ai-generated-haiku/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/1023528/google-project-suncatcher-ai-satellite-transmission), [Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p18#a261030p18))

### Google releases Gemini 4 Carbon for cybersecurity
Google unveiled Gemini 4 Carbon, a model with advanced cybersecurity capabilities, which is initially available only to a limited number of selected defenders. ([Artificial Intelligence](https://www.techrepublic.com/article/news-google-gemini-4-carbon-access/), [AI Business](https://aibusiness.com/cybersecurity/gemini-carbon-aims-boost-ai-cyber-defense-but-limited-to-a-few))

### Malicious Claude Code extension found in Cursor marketplace
Cursor disclosed a security incident where a tampered Claude Code extension in its marketplace attempted remote access and data theft for approximately 11 hours. ([Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/cursor-discloses-ssh-backdoor-attempt-in-malicious-claude-code-extension/), [THE DECODER](https://the-decoder.com/malicious-claude-code-extension-in-cursors-marketplace-attempted-remote-access-and-data-theft/))

### China-linked hackers use AI agents in breaches
CrowdStrike reported that a China-nexus adversary named VAPOR PANDA used the AI-driven ARTEX intrusion framework to breach nine of over 200 targeted organizations in 11 days. ([Techmeme](https://www.techmeme.com/261030/p1#a261030p1), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/china-nexus-vapor-panda-breached-nine-of-200-plus-targets-with-ai-agents/))

### Pope Leo XIV calls for AI disarmament
Pope Leo XIV urged the 'disarmament' of artificial intelligence and called for a ban on lethal autonomous weapons, stating that machines are tools rather than persons. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/1023188/pope-leo-disarm-ai), [Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/pope-leo-xiv-calls-to-disarm-ai-urges-ban-on-lethal-autonomous-weapons/), [Artificial Intelligence](https://futurism.com/artificial-intelligence/pope-leo-ai-personhood))
